title: The Struggle Against Anger
english: Having an unceasing enemy, he struggles. Therefore, it is a great achievement to hold back anger, and a great strategy against the spirit of anger.
It is not only spoken concerning a prostitute, but also concerning an evil desire; for when [...]
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The crookedness of the heart
english: When the mind is incited toward evil action, then the heart meditates on the crooked things which the mouth speaks. For then it will be like a sea in the heart, under the salt of many thoughts.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Drowning Pilot
english: He is being overwhelmed and is like a pilot in a great storm, being driven by the waves of evil desire toward wicked practice in his struggle.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
